approval.note: Native withdrawal quotation with source/runtime identity and block-pinned read adapter. Does not guarantee investor execution, market price or exclusivity of internal pricing.

runtime.note: Current-block native Curve withdrawal path; units, balances, code identity, available pause/blacklist checks and final block hash verified before LIVE.

valuation.formula: a0 = 10^LPDecimals; a1 = 0x2482DFb5A65D901d137742AB1095f26374509352.calc_withdraw_one_coin(uint256,int128)(a0, 1); a2 = 0xbEbc44782C7dB0a1A60Cb6fe97d0b483032FF1C7.calc_withdraw_one_coin(uint256,int128)(a1, 2); USDT per 1 LP = a2 / 10^6. All reads pinned to the same block.
valuation.methodology: Protocol-native LP redemption calculation, directly or through successive underlying LP claims. Includes pool withdrawal fees and native rounding. A verified zap, when configured as quote contract, returns exactly the composed final USDT amount.

inputParameters.name: token_amount
inputParameters.meaning: Exactly one whole root LP token

inputParameters.name: i
inputParameters.meaning: Final USDT index in zap, or selected coin of first pool

limitations: Native single-coin redemption quote, not an LP market price, NAV or guaranteed future execution price.
Composed routes apply each native withdrawal calculation and fee; no stablecoin parity assumption.
Pool activity establishes operation of the LP pool, not continuity or endorsement of every underlying coin issuer.
Curve pools may contain volatile or legacy assets and external protocol rate mechanisms.
No proof of exclusive internal pricing or aggregator rejection.
One-LP quotation does not establish full-supply liquidation proceeds.
The first call returns an intermediate LP amount, not USDT. Never enable generic ETH_CALL_UINT256 for this configuration; execute the full documented path.
LIVE is a current native withdrawal quotation with code, units, coin and cash checks; actual investor execution and full-supply liquidation are not guaranteed.

value.note: Final USDT redemption reference for exactly 1 whole root LP. Dated snapshot; LIVE disabled.

referenceSnapshot.note: Final USDT redemption reference for exactly 1 whole root LP. Dated snapshot; LIVE disabled.
